text: アスカナいせきは　すくなくとも　つくられてから　１５００ねんは　たってるが…　なんのために　つくられたかは　まったく　わかって　いないんだ

structure.jp: すくなくとも　つくられてから　１５００ねんは　たってるが…
structure.en: at least 1,500 years have passed since they were built, but...

structure.jp: なんのために　つくられたかは
structure.en: as for what they were built for

structure.jp: まったく　わかって　いないんだ
structure.en: it is not known at all

patterns.name: 〜てから
patterns.explanation: から after a て-form means 'since' or 'after' doing that. つくられてから = 'since they were built'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: The られる ending here says the thing has the action done to it, without saying who did it. つくられて = 'being built'.

patterns.name: 〜か (embedded question)
patterns.span: なんのために　つくられたか
patterns.explanation: か after a plain verb wraps a question up inside a bigger sentence. なんのために　つくられたか = 'what they were built for'.
